# How to get Started {.unnumbered}

## The Jedi Temple

For this mission, we have chosen Airmeet as our virtual Jedi Temple, your command center for training in the ways of the Force. Keep your eyes peeled for a separate holo-transmission (email) delivering your exclusive access codes. Before you embark on your quest, unlock the secrets of the Airmeet Holocron by watching the [**intro video**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JCijIXQ4ZqQ&t) and complete your Jedi profile so you can connect with other participants.

## Jedi Training in Posit Cloud

### Mission Log: Order 01 - Initiating Contact With the Rebel Base

-   Open your web browser and go to [**Posit Cloud**](https://rstudio.cloud/).
-   Click **Sign Up** and create your account.
-   Use the same email address you used to register for the workshop.
-   Confirm your account using the verification email.

### Mission Log: Order 02 - Entering the Secret Rebel Workshop Base

-   Return to [**Posit Cloud**](https://rstudio.cloud/) and log in.
-   One day before the workshop, you will receive the workshop-space link by email.

### Mission Log: Order 03 - Joining the Fellowship of the Force

-   Enter the workshop space and open the `PopGenJedi` project.
-   The first launch may take a little time while the environment is prepared.

### Mission Log: Order 04 - Teleporting Your Data Scrolls to the Cloud Realm

-   Open the **Files** tab in the lower-right panel.
-   Click **Upload**.
-   Select your file and confirm with **Open** and **OK**.

### Mission Log: Order 05 - Installing R in Your Own Star Destroyer (Optional)

Most workshop activities run directly in the cloud environment. If you prefer local setup, use:

-   [**R, RStudio, and dartR installation tutorial**](https://github.com/green-striped-gecko/dartR/wiki/Installation-tutorial)
-   [**Guide to update R and RStudio**](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/3-methods-update-r-rstudio-windows-mac-woratana-ngarmtrakulchol/)

Update your installed packages before the workshop:

```r
update.packages(ask = FALSE)
```

## Required Jedi Training

### Mission Log: Order 00 - What You Must Already Know

#### R Combat Training

Before the workshop, you should be comfortable with:

-   RStudio interface and script editing
-   Basic data types (vectors, matrices, data frames, lists)
-   Basic operations and assignment
-   Basic R functions
-   Subsetting and indexing

Core pre-work resources:

-   [**OneDrive Holocron (R basics)**](https://1drv.ms/f/s!AlB_j_RzSQLwgTp4aQm5p927oTxl?e=uBvUyN)
-   [**Free Introduction to R course**](https://www.datacamp.com/courses/free-introduction-to-r)

### The Jedi Archives: Advanced Reading

### Population Genetics: Ancient Jedi Wisdom

Make sure you review the foundational population genetics material:

-   [**OneDrive Chest (PopGen basics)**](https://1drv.ms/f/s!AlB_j_RzSQLwgUBMWcrqh40A3YHs?e=gwbP2f)
-   [**Population and Quantitative Genetics (Graham Coop)**](https://github.com/cooplab/popgen-notes/releases/download/v1.2/minicoop.pdf)
-   [**Theoretical Evolutionary Genetics (Joe Felsenstein)**](https://felsenst.github.io/pgbook/pgbook.pdf)
-   [**Lecture Notes (Kent Holsinger)**](https://figshare.com/articles/journal_contribution/Lecture_notes_in_population_genetics/100687)
